headline: 13 Ethereum L1 contracts catalogued from official Ink docs and Etherscan; canonical OP Stack bridge with ProxyAdmin owned by SuperchainProxyAdminOwner
short_headline: 13 L1 contracts, OP Stack canonical bridge

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'Ink' on Ethereum mainnet surfaced 'Ink: L1 Standard Bridge' at 0x88FF1e5b602916615391F55854588EFcBB7663f0 and 'Ink: Proxy Admin' at 0xd56045E68956FCe2576E680c95a4750cf8241f79 and 'Ink: L1 Cross Domain Messenger' at 0x69d3Cf86B2Bf1a9e99875B7e2D9B6a84426c171f via internal transactions visible on the Etherscan page.

Official deployed-contracts doc at https://docs.inkonchain.com/useful-information/contracts lists 13 L1 Ethereum mainnet contracts (AddressManager, AnchorStateRegistry, DelayedWETHPermissionedGame, DisputeGameFactory, ERC5564Announcer, ERC6538Registry, L1CrossDomainMessenger, L1ERC721Bridge, L1StandardBridge, OptimismMintableERC20Factory, OptimismPortal, ProxyAdmin, SystemConfig) plus 17 Ink L2 predeploys. All addresses recorded in admin_addresses.
No audit_links recorded in protocol context. The Etherscan page for the L1 Standard Bridge proxy notes 'No Contract Security Audit Submitted'. No audit PDF found this run.

protocol.github is listed as none. The inkonchain.com website links to https://github.com/inkonchain as the GitHub org. The docs page links to https://github.com/inkonchain/docs for editing. No deployment artifacts (run-latest.json, deployments/*.json) were found because no specific repo was pinned; addresses instead sourced from the docs MDX page itself (https://github.com/inkonchain/docs/blob/main/src/pages/useful-information/contracts.mdx mentioned inline on docs page).

L2 predeploy addresses (0x42000...0010 etc.) are standard OP Stack predeploys on Ink L2 and are noted but not fetchable via the defipunkd on-chain API this run. D5 is not applicable for multi-chain enumeration beyond what was covered in D2.
DisputeGameFactory at 0x10d7b35078d3baabb96dd45a9143b94be65b12cd could spawn child dispute games. No enumeration of active dispute games attempted this run; factory address recorded for next run.

L2Beat confirms ProxyAdmin owner is SuperchainProxyAdminOwner (Optimism Foundation multisig), actor_class=multisig.

All 13 L1 addresses trace to the fetched docs URL https://docs.inkonchain.com/useful-information/contracts (fetched this run) and are confirmed by Etherscan name tags visible in the fetched Etherscan page. protocol_metadata.about: Ink Bridge is the canonical OP Stack bridge connecting Ethereum mainnet to Ink, an optimistic rollup Layer 2 blockchain built by Kraken on the OP Stack and part of the Optimism Superchain. Users deposit ETH or ERC-20 tokens by locking assets in the L1StandardBridge on Ethereum, which mints equivalent representations on Ink L2; withdrawals follow the standard OP Stack 7-day challenge period via the OptimismPortal. The bridge infrastructure is governed by a ProxyAdmin contract whose owner is the Optimism Foundation's SuperchainProxyAdminOwner multisig, shared across the Superchain. Ink launched mainnet in December 2024 and positions itself as the DeFi hub of the Superchain.
